disclosure: FIXTURE DATA — simulated API and model responses produced by `notary demo --fixture`; not a live run

PLANTED FIXTURE QUIRKS (simulated, not claims about the real APIs): Q1 GET /payments, GET /refunds: page_size > 100 (documented max) is accepted and silently clamped to 100; Q2 POST /customers/{id}/wallets/ledger-entries: `amount` is read in MAJOR units: crediting 1000 adds 100000 minor units; INTERMITTENT: amounts from 3000 to 3999 are read correctly (minor units); Q3 POST /customers/{id}/wallets/ledger-entries: `idempotency_key` is ignored: each repeat of a keyed credit creates a new entry; Q4 POST /refunds (partial): `items[].amount` is read in MAJOR units and silently capped at the line price: every partial refund refunds the whole item; Q5 POST /refunds (full): no duplicate protection (a retried full refund creates a second refund), and full refunds answer slowly; Q6 POST /company/enrich: notion.so funding.total_investment_usd comes back as the string "$343M"
Reflector and adversary are deterministic model doubles (fixture model, no cost); token counts are estimates, usd 0.
Probe caps raised for the fixture demo only: 6 per claim, 40 per run (live defaults 5 and 30).
Expected outcomes: fixtures/queue/expected.json, hand-written from the policy table before any run.

Guarded variant: every tool call goes through guards compiled from notarized beliefs; irreversible actions run only when all their required beliefs are notarized, else held with an evidence pack; writes are never retried blindly (read back first).
Graded deterministically from Dodo state read back by full pagination before and after the run; no LLM grades anything.
Guards: 5 active, compiled from 9 notarized belief(s) in the Notary store.

Required-beliefs gap (partial_refund): No doc claim on rounding (DECISIONS #22); covered by exact-echo unit probes on partial refunds plus integer-typed refund amounts, and amounts are floored client-side.
Required-beliefs gap (plan_change): No doc claim on immediate vs next-billing-date semantics (DECISIONS #22); the guarded executor sends effective_at=immediately explicitly.
